title: Bestektekening blokken 1-4 type A: plattegronden
text: Floor plans of the type A terraced house at 1:100: begane grond (living room, kitchen, toilet), verdieping (three bedrooms, bathroom) and zolder (attic). Drawn by Bureau Van Dalen & Kroon, architects, dated 6-3-1972.

title: Bestektekening blokken 1-4 type A: gevels en doorsnede
text: Front and rear elevations (voorgevel, achtergevel) and cross-section A-A of type A at 1:100. Ridge height 9,20 m above peil; roof pitch 40 degrees.

title: Bestektekening type B: plattegronden en gevels
text: Floor plans and elevations of the type B end-of-terrace house (kopwoning) at 1:100, with a side entrance and a fourth bedroom on the verdieping.

title: Detail spouwmuur en kozijnaansluiting
text: Construction detail of the outer wall at 1:5: 'spouwmuur, buitenblad 100 mm baksteen, spouw 50 mm, binnenblad 100 mm kalkzandsteen'. No cavity insulation is drawn ('spouw ongeisoleerd'). Timber window frames (houten kozijnen) with single glazing.

title: Detail begane grondvloer en kruipruimte
text: Ground floor detail at 1:5: 'prefab kanaalplaatvloer 200 mm' resting on concrete foundation beams (funderingsbalken), over a crawl space (kruipruimte) 50 cm high, accessible through a hatch in the hall. No floor insulation is drawn.

title: Detail dakvoet en dakbeschot
text: Roof detail at 1:5: pitched roof with timber purlins (gordingen), roof boarding (dakbeschot) and concrete roof tiles. The drawing shows no roof insulation.

title: Palenplan blok 1
text: Pile plan of block 1 by Ingenieursbureau Mertens: 26 prefab concrete piles 25 x 25 cm, length 13,00 m below peil. First pile driven on 12 March 1973.

title: Palenplan blok 2
text: Pile plan of block 2 by Ingenieursbureau Mertens: 24 prefab concrete piles 25 x 25 cm, length 13,50 m below peil.

title: Palenplan blok 3
text: Pile plan of block 3 by Ingenieursbureau Mertens: 28 prefab concrete piles 25 x 25 cm, length 14,50 m below peil, deeper than blocks 1 and 2 because of a peat layer found in the soil survey.

title: Palenplan blok 4
text: Pile plan of block 4 by Ingenieursbureau Mertens: 24 prefab concrete piles 25 x 25 cm, length 13,00 m below peil.

title: Funderingsplan blokken 1-4
text: Foundation plan: reinforced concrete foundation beams (funderingsbalken) 400 x 600 mm on the piles, with the positions of the crawl space hatches.

title: Sonderingen en grondonderzoek
text: Soil survey (sonderingen) with four cone penetration tests; a peat layer between 6 and 9 m below peil under block 3.

title: Installatietekening verwarming en gas
text: Heating and gas installation: one gas-fired room heater (gaskachel) in the living room and a gas water heater (geiser) in the kitchen. No central heating (geen cv) is drawn.

title: Installatietekening ventilatie
text: Ventilation: natural ventilation through grilles above the window frames, with a mechanical extract only in the toilet and bathroom.

title: Installatietekening elektra
text: Electrical installation: one group per floor, meter cupboard (meterkast) in the hall next to the front door.

title: Rioleringstekening
text: Drainage plan (riolering): concrete sewer pipes under the crawl space, rainwater (hemelwater) and foul water on one combined system to the municipal sewer.

title: Situatietekening complex Zuiderhof
text: Site plan at 1:500 of complex Zuiderhof: 48 houses in four blocks of 12 (blokken 1-4), gardens to the south-west, parking along the street.

title: Bouwvergunning
text: Building permit (bouwvergunning) for 48 houses, granted by the municipality on 14 November 1972.

title: Gereedmelding
text: Completion notice (gereedmelding): block 1 and 2 handed over on 2 May 1974, blocks 3 and 4 on 15 August 1974.

title: Aannemer: bouwplanning
text: Contractor's schedule by Bouwbedrijf De Ridder: start of piling March 1973, roofs closed (dak dicht) per block between October 1973 and April 1974.

title: Archiefnotitie: revisietekeningen
text: The archive holds no as-built drawings (revisietekeningen). Changes made during construction or later renovations are not recorded in this archive.

title: Archiefnotitie: asbest
text: The archive holds no asbestos inventory (asbestinventarisatie) for this complex; the drawings do not name the materials of the roof boarding or the pipe insulation.

title: Archiefnotitie: energielabel
text: The archive holds no energy label, insulation measurement or energy assessment for these houses.
